verdict.rationale: ZCode is itself an AI coding agent and workbench (desktop, web, and terminal agent), so it occupies the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows ZCode running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' subcommand or a hosted MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
